intent: Make existing explicit document-ref/moduleId/stable-nodeID recommendation reviewable with three exact fixture-bound samples; no source/schema write or inferred ownership.

existing_source_facts.missing_identity: design section lacks a document ID attribute, therefore embedded-design cannot be equated to it from current file alone
existing_source_facts.packet_behavior: SPEC packet always emits UI_SCOPE_UNRESOLVED+UI_DOCUMENT_UNRESOLVED and NOT_READY; selected nodes+context IDs only, no design bodies
existing_source_facts.codec: Integrated .ess design is eluslot.esui XML; dedicated .sgendesign Rust codec is sgenaxis.design JSON with id/type/parentId/props/hints. Do not convert or conflate these formats.

samples.meaning: Explicit alias+assignment sample; consumes only exact design-button, context-only NOT_READY
As-is current fixture; no inference from node adjacency/names/moduleRef or all design IDs
Overlapping wrong-module assignment plus missing/dangling/multiple/stale negative mutation cases; reject all selected UI bodies

hexagonal_view:
Human-authored explicit binding request (driving input; proposed new mapping authority)
  ↓ HOST existing packet query orchestration
  ↓ SPEC pure binding validation/projection (proposed, unapproved)
  ↑ existing decoder port / adapter reads explicitly supplied .ess bytes
  → derived context projection only
SPEC/GUARD/EVID own readiness/approval, never mapping request or HTML.
dependency_view:
HOST → SPEC policy + existing ports
XML adapter → existing decoder abstraction
explicit mapping bytes + mapping SHA ─┐
source .ess bytes + source SHA ──────┼→ validated projection (no writeback)
module member/UI/document/node IDs ──┘
Domain/other modules unchanged; no new Manager/port/crate or inferred model.

proposed_consumption_contract.meaning: Caller explicitly provides source file and mapping bytes; no search/discovery/external reference following. First validate normal existing project-relative path policy. Proposed first slice .ess embedded design only; external .esui/.sgendesign NOT_SUPPORTED/NOT_READY, no format expansion.

SHA256 exact complete .ess bytes, not normalized XML. mapping source.sha256 must match and each document binding source_sha256 must match. HOST re-read freshness before response; source change => NOT_READY/stale with no body publication.

Exact case-sensitive architecture_document_ref must equal selected UI uiDefinitionRef. A nonempty hint alone proves nothing; explicit one-to-one alias declaration binds exact /eluslotScene/design in same SHA-bound source. Unsupported selector or zero/multiple design sections rejects.
module_id resolves actual moduleId not slotId; architecture_ui_node_id must be unique kind UI and declared member of exactly selected module, with matching moduleRef/layerRef per current contract.

design_node_ids are exact unique IDs within declared document; every ID exists exactly once. No auto descendants, parent expansion, node-name matching, spatial proximity, module name matching or union across assignments.

One design node may belong to at most one module in this minimal proposal. Duplicate alias/assignment/overlap, dangling references or conflicting source hashes => diagnostic+NOT_READY; no first/last wins or partial-body success.

Missing mapping returns current unresolved packet unchanged. Valid mapping can produce separate derived MAPPED_CONTEXT_ONLY review projection, but current ModulePacket schema/readiness stay unchanged in first slice. No silently clearing existing unresolved diagnostics in formal packet.

Projection binds mapping exact-byte SHA256 as well as source SHA256; same source with different mapping is different projection. Mapping revision has no timestamp-based authority, and hashes prove identity not owner approval.

Mapping owns declared association only after explicit owner approval of this architecture; product files remain authoritative document bodies. Human-edited sample/HTML or unsigned client payload cannot authorize execution/acceptance. Raw product_pass, behaviorHints/bddHint/tddHint are not executable UI behavior or qualified tests.

No writes to .ess/.esui/.sgendesign, no migration/ID repair, no persistence of new mapping authority until owner chooses lifecycle/storage. Proposed first artifact explicit in-memory request; source/mapping error leaves existing product state untouched.

state_ownership: New explicit mapping request would become an additional authority for association only, not document content or product approval. This is architectural and currently unapproved. Prefer per-request immutable mapping bytes, no hidden sidecar autoload/canonical shadow state. Persistent storage/editor/export is a separate decision.
mutation_transaction: Read bytes→validate/hash→resolve all IDs→build temporary projection→freshness recheck→publish context-only. Any invalid mapping publishes diagnostics only, no partial resolved design bodies; product state/files unchanged.

bdd.given: Real fixture bytes and mapped.proposed.json with explicit alias/one module/one stable design ID
bdd.when: A read-only binding projection is requested
bdd.then: Only design-button is associated as proposed context; source/mapping hashes bind result and readiness remains NOT_READY
Current unresolved diagnostics remain and no design body is attributed

bdd.given: Conflict sample or duplicate document alias
bdd.then: Conflict is visible, no precedence selection occurs, readiness NOT_READY and no partial selected bodies

bdd.given: Mapping references missing design node or wrong module/UI member
bdd.then: Readable dangling/membership rejection occurs without altering source

bdd.given: A mapping hash-bound to previous source bytes
bdd.then: Projection is stale/NOT_READY and no old association is asserted as current

bdd.given: A valid association plus product_pass true or approval-like mapping text
bdd.then: Association never produces READY/execution/acceptance and formal packet schema remains unchanged

ac: Three proposals validate against recorded real fixture identities and exact source SHA; samples explicitly PROPOSED not official schema
Independent tests after approval cover mapped/unmapped/conflict/missing/dangling/multiple/stale and no extra node leakage
Missing/invalid mapping never inferred, repaired or partially accepted; no original document or formal schema write
All projections include exact source+mapping hashes, selectors and referenced IDs; source freshness and mapping change detected
ModulePacket v1 and current readiness unchanged for first slice; context-only projection is not execution approval
No new dependency/port/Manager/state store; no external file follow or .sgendesign conversion
Owner explicitly accepts extra mapping association authority and its request-only lifecycle before skeleton/RED/implementation
allowed_files_candidates_after_approval: Potential pure helper private to existing sgenaxis-spec packet.rs; separate derived result API shape requires explicit review before approval
Existing HOST module_packet.rs orchestration only if needed to pass explicit mapping bytes/freshness; exact function boundary frozen after decision
One separate frozen integration test module and copied disposable fixtures; originals protected
protected: Existing public ModulePacket v1/readiness/error contract without further approval
UI save/load handlers, design codec, persistent mapping store, Agent/Guard authorization
cost: Proposed first slice one pure validator + HOST request orchestration if approved; 0 new crate/Manager/port. Exact new result/input surface is a decision item, not preauthorized source change.
